description: Redistributable ComfyUI API-format workflows and explicit parameter mappings for CharacterLock Studio.

workflows.name: Qwen 2.1 · Sheet padrão 9 vistas por descrição

config.prompt_template: Create a realistic standard close-up reference portrait of an original fictional adult character. Identity profile: {identity}. Front-facing head and shoulders, camera at eye level, face centred and prominent, complete head and hair visible, plain pale grey studio background, even soft light, natural skin. Fully clothed in modest casual clothing. This close-up defines the face for the connected profile, three-quarter, body and pose views.

workflows.name: MATRIX Qwen 2.1 · Expressões e rosto (8 imagens)

config.prompt_template:
Same person as <image1>. Neutral relaxed expression, lips softly closed, calm direct gaze into the camera, head level and facing the camera straight-on. Shoulder-up portrait framed from the upper chest up, the whole head and hair visible, wearing the same clothing as in <image1>, plain soft grey studio background, soft even studio light, the face in sharp focus, realistic skin with natural texture and visible pores. Keep the face, hair, skin and exact eye colour of <image1>. Any further reference pictures show the same person from other angles. Realistic photograph.

Character identity profile: {identity}

Keep the face, hair, skin and exact eye colour of <image1>. Any further reference pictures show the same person from other angles. Realistic photograph.

Same person: <image1> shows the face, <image2> shows the upper body and the outfit. Change the pose: the person faces the camera straight-on. Half-body from the hips up, standing straight with the arms relaxed slightly away from the body, camera at chest height about 2 metres away, no wide-angle distortion, the face and torso sharp. Keep the exact body shape and proportions of <image2>: the same shoulder width, bust, waist and arm shape; do not make the body slimmer, curvier or more muscular. Wearing exactly the clothing of <image2>, the same garments, colours and fit; ignore the clothing in <image1>. Plain soft grey studio background, soft even studio light, realistic skin with natural texture. Keep the exact face, hair and eye colour of <image1>. Any further reference pictures show the same person and the same outfit from other angles. Realistic photograph. No motion blur, no double exposure.

Character identity profile: {identity}
